title: argus providers names the provider and model and exits non-zero when it is unreachable

rust.note: argus-next implements only --help and --version in P0; commands arrive in later phases (spec section 12)

files.content:
provider: ollama
providers:
  ollama:
    model: conformance-model
    base_url: http://127.0.0.1:9
budgets:
  time_minutes: 1

note: The configured Ollama URL is a closed local port and all proxies are dead, so the connection check fails without network access. ARG-01 adds readiness states in the Rust line; the exit code stays non-zero for an unreachable provider.
